training.geometry_error_limit_derivation: Prior held-out terrain residual / measured map-to-minimap scale + sqrt(2)/2 reference-pixel quantization
training.score_threshold: Retain 0.700; check both positive and negative distributions, do not lower it
training.distinct_radius: Existing 8-reference-pixel arrival scale, grouping adjacent samples of one peak; immediate runner-up also recorded
training.limitations: One stationary pose, correlated frames; geometry used frame 001. Not independent region generalization or live certification.
